title: Act 1 - Segment 2: Mt. Moon to Cerulean City (Cascade Badge)
synopsis: Trek across Route 3, navigate the cavernous heights of Mt. Moon, conquer Route 24's Nugget Bridge, assist Bill at Sea Cottage for the S.S. Ticket, and battle Gym Leader Misty in a 2v2 duel under the Level 25 Hard Mode cap.
